title: psychotria hombroniana var. hirtella
intro: Psychotria hombroniana var. hirtella, commonly known as a species of flowering plant in the Rubiaceae family, is a type of medicinal plant traditionally used in Southeast Asian countries. The health benefits of Psychotria hombroniana var. hirtella include its ability to treat fever, rheumatism, and other inflammatory conditions, as well as its use as an antimalarial and antibacterial agent. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which exert antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects. The bioactive constituents of Psychotria hombroniana var. hirtella have been identified as including psychotridine, hombronianine, and hirtelline, among others, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
